canonical_title: Presentation Methods and Learning Activities for Competency Development
aliases: Selecting presentation methods and learning activities
Methods for knowledge, skills and attitudes

one_line_answer.text: Learning activities are simply tasks which are integrated into a session to promote learning.

cites.quote: Learning activities are simply tasks which are integrated into a session to promote learning.

bangla_explanation: Learning activities হলো session-এর ভেতরে রাখা ছোট ছোট কাজ, যাতে শেখা হয়।
Competency-র কোন অংশ শেখাচ্ছেন, সেই অনুযায়ী method বাছুন: knowledge, skills নাকি attitudinal changes।
Questioning আর visual aids সব topic areas-এ চলে।
Visual aids attention ধরে, কারণ দেখা learners-এর dominant learning sense।

example.en: A garments OSH trainer uses a fire case study. Workers then reflect on their own practices.
example.bn: গার্মেন্টসে OSH awareness শেখাতে trainer আগুন লাগার case study দেন, তারপর workers-রা নিজেদের অভ্যাস নিয়ে ভাবেন (reflection)।

list_answer.title: Learning activities for each component of competency
list_answer.title_bn: Competency-র প্রতিটি অংশের জন্য learning activities

items.text: Knowledge concepts: documenting, reading and reflecting.

cites.quote: If you are presenting knowledge concepts your learning
activities will probably be documenting, reading and reflecting.

items.text: Work skills: learning activities that involve observing and doing.

cites.quote: teaching work skills, you are more likely to use learning activities that involve
observing and doing.

items.text: Attitudinal changes (e.g. OSH awareness): case study and reflection based activity.

cites.quote: If you are developing attitudinal changes (e.g. OSH awareness)
you would probably involve the learners in a case study and reflection based activity

items_bn: Knowledge শেখাতে: লেখা (documenting), পড়া আর চিন্তা করা (reflecting)।
কাজের skills শেখাতে: দেখা (observing) আর নিজে করা (doing)।
মনোভাব বদলাতে, যেমন OSH awareness: case study আর reflection ভিত্তিক activity।

short.prompt: How do you select learning activities for knowledge, skills and attitudes?
short.modelAnswer:
Learning activities are tasks integrated into a session to promote learning.
1. Knowledge concepts: documenting, reading and reflecting.
2. Work skills: observing and doing.
3. Attitudinal changes (e.g. OSH awareness): case study and reflection.
Questioning and visual aids are used across all topic areas.
